name: Megami-sama ☆ ni Onegai!! -Mayonaka no Boukensha-
original_name: 女神さま☆にお願いっ!! －真夜中の冒険者－
source:
A certain Tokyo high school is an ordinary school during daytime, but at nighttime it changes into a labyrinth that seals the ultimate treasure that can make any wish come true. Main character is one of its students joining in the treasure hunt accompanied by classmate girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
東京某所高中白天只是一所普通學校，到了夜晚卻會變成一座迷宮，封印著能夠實現任何願望的終極寶物。主角是這所學校的學生，與幾名女同學一起加入尋寶行動。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
